verdict.rationale: Calendar sync is a fair question for a CRM, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack never documents calendar syncing or meetings appearing on contact or deal timelines. The nearby items are different features and earn no credit: 'Real-time contact syncing', generic 'full history of every interaction' marketing, and call recording/transcription.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can sync my calendar so meetings appear on contact and deal timelines
